text:
mira (support): FYI we have a customer (alan-inc) hitting repeated 429s during a live demo. Also seeing a handful of 401s mixed in. They're on the free tier. Asking if we can do a short, sales-assisted uplift for 4 hours so their demo finishes.

devon (eng-oncall): Can you paste the request_id and a short repro? 429s usually either concurrency or token-per-minute. 401s could be a rotated key.

mira (support): request_id: rq_20260317001, repro steps from the customer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_key" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-opus-8k","prompt":"summary of dataset","max_tokens":200}'
```
They report it happens after ~6 parallel requests.

devon (eng-oncall): That strongly suggests free-tier concurrency ceiling (we cap parallel streams). I pulled the logs for rq_20260317001 — backend returned 429 with X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 and X-Concurrency-Limit: 6. Also a few 401s with code: AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN at 2026-03-17T15:12:08Z. Looks like one of their rotating keys failed mid-demo.

mira (support): Customer says they rotate keys automatically between two tokens; maybe one key expired. They asked for a temporary uplift to 12 concurrent streams for 4 hours.

sam (sales): I can approve a short trial uplift but need billing contact & quick agreement. @kyra (billing-bot) can you check if alan-inc has a verified billing email on file and whether we can enable a one-time pilot-cap boost? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kyra (billing-bot): alan-inc is on free tier. No billing email on file. Policy requires either a PO or signed pilot agreement for >24h reserved capacity. For sub-24h temporary boosts we allow a sales-authorized grace if risk is low. Please confirm SRE/Eng sign-off. Link: https://redwood.ai/internal/billing/pilot-boosts

devon (eng-oncall): Operationally low-risk for 4 hours. We can set a soft concurrency bump on their API key to 12 and monitor. Need the exact API key (or ask them to create a temporary key) — we should not accept keys over chat. Also advise them to stop automated rotation during the demo or ensure both tokens valid.

mira (support): Noted. I told them to generate a temporary key and sent the minimal repro to confirm. Customer will provide the new key in the secure form.

sam (sales): Once kyra confirms we can proceed, I'll send the pilot agreement via DocuSign (4hr uplift note + audit). Also will loop in account exec to follow up on paid plan.

mira (support): Quick checklist before uplift:
- customer creates temp API key and submits via secure form (link provided)
- confirm they won't rotate during the 4h window
- we set soft concurrency to 12 for that key only
- monitor logs & revert after 4h

devon (eng-oncall): Add alerts: error-rate > 5% or latency P95 > 2s => auto-revert. I'll create a short runbook entry and tag the key.

ops-bot: deploy note: temporary-cap-bump applied to key: key-redacted for 4h by devon — monitoring active.

mira (support): Customer confirmed temp key submitted via secure form and billing contact email added. Going to approve the uplift now.

kyra (billing-bot): Pilot uplift approved (internal ref: PILOT-742). Sales must close the DocuSign. Reminder: any usage beyond demo may trigger billing outreach.

mira (support): Closing loop with customer: 4h uplift active, watch for 401s (token rotation) and let us know immediately if you see errors. Good luck with the demo :rocket:

sam (sales): Follow-up: If they convert to paid within 7 days we can roll the uplift into a 30-day pilot offer. I'll schedule a touchpoint.

devon (eng-oncall): Postmortem note: recommend adding a short FAQ to onboarding about key rotation + demo windows to prevent similar bursts.

mira (support): Agreed — adding a KB article. Thread closed after uplift confirmed.
